note: All three tests verified against the CDC STEADI assessment forms (2017) kept in sources/.

chairStand.rule: A score below the number for the person's age and sex is below average.
chairStand.source: CDC STEADI 30-Second Chair Stand form, as reported in search results (research memo O-033, 2026-10-13). Norms trace to Rikli & Jones (1999).
chairStand.verifiedAgainst: sources/CDC-STEADI-30sec-chair-stand-2017.pdf (CDC STEADI 30-Second Chair Stand assessment form, 2017; provided by the CEO 2026-10-13). Every row and both scoring notes checked line by line.

scoringNotes.armsUsed: If the arms are used to stand, the score is 0.
scoringNotes.partialStand: A stand counts if the person is more than halfway up at 30 seconds.
scoringNotes.source: sources/CDC-STEADI-30sec-chair-stand-2017.pdf (CDC STEADI 30-Second Chair Stand assessment form, 2017; provided by the CEO 2026-10-13). Every row and both scoring notes checked line by line.

balance.rule: Not holding the tandem stance (stage 3) for 10 seconds is outside the CDC range.
stages: Semi-tandem: the instep of one foot touches the big toe of the other
Tandem: one foot in front of the other, heel touching toe
balance.source: Search results only: clinical-trial registry entry and a consumer article (research memo O-033). The CDC 4-Stage Balance Test page was not opened.
balance.verifiedAgainst: sources/CDC-STEADI-4stage-balance-2017.pdf (CDC STEADI 4-Stage Balance Test form, 2017; provided by the CEO 2026-10-13): 10-second holds; stop at the first position not held; an older adult who cannot hold the tandem stand for at least 10 seconds is at increased risk of falling; no assistive device (cane or walker); eyes open.
balance.conditions: No cane or walker; eyes open; a helper stands next to the person.

tug.rule: 12 seconds or more is outside the CDC range.
tug.timing: Start on the word Go; stop when the person is seated again.
tug.source: Search results only (research memo O-033). The CDC STEADI TUG form was not opened.
tug.verifiedAgainst: sources/CDC-STEADI-TUG-2017.pdf (CDC STEADI Timed Up & Go assessment form, 2017; provided by the CEO 2026-10-13): line 3 meters or 10 feet away; start timing on 'Go', stop after the patient sits back down; an older adult who takes >=12 seconds is at risk for falling; regular footwear; walking aid allowed; normal pace.
tug.conditions: Regular footwear; usual walking aid allowed; normal pace; a helper stays close.
